published.source: Scorpid Sting duty preset (standards 23), rotation audit pass 20 (2026-10-15): 180 s, 20000 iterations, seed 1

verify.note: verify.py, same sim as the published number

summary: Beast Mastery 31/20 with a 1.0 sec cat: Bestial Wrath, Frenzy, Ferocity and Unleashed Fury, plus Careful Aim and Mortal Shots in Marksmanship. The pet deals about 21% of its damage; it is the pet-focused build, 68 DPS behind Marksmanship at 180 s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3 s, Rapid Fire at -0.1 s
Bestial Wrath (0 and 120 s), Rapid Fire, racials, Sapper and potions on cooldown
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 4 s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Cat (1.0 sec) bites and claws on cooldown, Frenzy up about 178 of 180 s; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and 415 ranged attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown

Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power and Hunter's Mark's 140 (assumption hunter_tsa_hm_rank, user ruling 2026-10-15: Blizzard fixes both onto the curve; the client has 50 and 71, below the older ranks' 75 and 98)
Aspect of the Hawk held at rank 5 (90 RAP) since Forever's rank 6 gives only 55
Pet scaling: 10% of RAP plus hunter hit (SoD placeholder for hit); on SoD's full 22% pet scaling this build would gain +41 (2026-10-12 gear)
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (the forever-hunter wiki; the beta log fit was 11% / 3.5%)
Auto Shot fires through casts with no 0.5 sec aim (open assumption)
Wildstalker Armor 4P/5P not in the preset (2P only); with them this build would gain +1 (measured on the 2026-10-12 gear)
Pet consumables are off (Forever pets take no player buffs); they would add 17 if allowed
Intimidation is talented but not cast by the rotation
Major Frenzy Potion is +5 at 120/180 s but 19 behind at 300 s, so Major Mana Potion ships
22% more crit per Agility than Classic (assumption hunter_crit_per_agi, user ruling 2026-10-15: the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60)

A pet's hit scales with its attack speed as in Classic (assumption hunter_pet_speed, user ruling 2026-10-15; on the beta every pet hits like a 2.0 sec pet); the cat is still the best pet and every cat speed sims within 1 DPS

The ranged weapon is a 2.5 sec bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS (Striker's Mark's speed and spread, standards 22 Ranged). A 2.6 sec gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, but 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era Phase 1's sure 14% pouch (Ribbly's Bandolier), and the 15% quiver only takes arrows

Scorpid Sting duty (standards 23): the request switches the raid's Scorpid Sting off and the hunter keeps its own up in place of Serpent Sting; it costs 82.5 / 83.0 / 83.5 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300 s against hunter__beast-mastery, most of it Serpent Sting's damage
The sting only lowers the boss's hit (2%, the slot it shares with Insect Swarm, whose raid debuff stays on), so it adds nothing to the raid's damage
notes: Request is hunter__beast-mastery's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/bm_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_bm_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_bm) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions.
